content.text: Now the stress test. First, capture/manifest scale (200k records, 65k targets) with trivial planning:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && timeout 170 python3 - << 'EOF'
import base64, io, csv, json, random, sys, time, ipaddress
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/deps'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
import zstandard as zstd
rng = random.Random(5)

# 65k-target manifest: 1985 leases x 1 subnet x 32 lows = 65505 targets
leases = []
for i in range(1985):
    leases.append({'id': f'L{i:04d}', 'prefix': f'2001:db8:{(i>>8)&0xff:x}:{(i&0xff):x}00::/56',
                   'start': 0, 'end': 100, 'subnets': [0], 'low_count': 32})
# 200k records spread over the first leases
HDR = ['type','id','revision','published','op','lease','event','probe','target','responder','result','service','attempt','payload']
buf = io.StringIO(newline='')
w = csv.writer(buf, lineterminator='\n')
w.writerow(HDR)
for k in range(200000):
    lid = f'L{k % 100:04d}'
    net = ipaddress.IPv6Network(leases[k % 100]['prefix'], strict=True)
    n = (k % 32) + 1
    tgt = str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(int(net.network_address) + n))
    row = [f'i{k}', str(k % 5), str(k % 20), 'put', lid, str(k % 20), f'0/i{n}', tgt, tgt, 'echo', '', '', '']
    w.writerow(['icmp'] + row if False else ['icmp', f'i{k}', str(k % 5), str(k % 20), 'put', lid,
                                             str(k % 20), f'0/i{n}', tgt, tgt, 'echo', '', '', ''])
data = buf.getvalue().encode()
print('csv bytes', len(data))
comp = zstd.ZstdCompressor(write_checksum=True).compress(data)
print('zstd bytes', len(comp))
def b64e(x): return base64.b64encode(x).decode()
job = {'version': 3, 'seed': 'sd', 'leases': leases,
       'services': [{'id': 'W', 'kind': 'tcp'}], 'queries': [10],
       'captures': [{'encoding': 'zstd', 'chunks': [b64e(comp[i:i+1000000]) for i in range(0, len(comp), 1000000)]}],
       'requests': [], 'offers': [],
       'request_quotas': [{'id': 'q0', 'parent': None, 'capacity': 10}],
       'offer_quotas': [{'id': 'p0', 'parent': None, 'capacity': 10}]}
raw = json.dumps(job).encode()
print('input bytes', len(raw))
open('/workspace/tmp/stress1.json','wb').write(raw)
t = time.time()
import subprocess
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/submission/campaign.py'],
                   input=raw, capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace/tmp')
dt = time.time() - t
res = json.loads(p.stdout)
print(f'runtime {dt:.1f}s manifest={len(res["manifest"])} rejected={len(res["rejected"])} '
      f'live={res["snapshots"][0]["ledger"]} stdout={len(p.stdout)}')
EOF
